;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[2018 Southern Syria offensive]]
***The [[Syrian Army]] seizes control of [[Al-Shajara, Syria|Al-Shajara]], described as [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]'s "main bastion" in the [[Daraa Governorate]]. [https://www.alaraby.co.uk/english/news/2018/7/30/is-collapse-following-syrian-regime-offensive-in-yarmouk-valley (''The New Arab'')]
**The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] (SOHR) reports that ISIL militants are holding more than 30 [[Druze people in Syria|Druze]] women and children hostage following [[2018 As-Suwayda attacks|last week's attacks]] on Druze villages in the [[As-Suwayda Governorate]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-45004063 (BBC)] 

;Business and economy
*[[Economy of Iran]] 
**The [[Iranian rial]] hits another record low against the [[US dollar]] ahead of August 7, when the first round of fresh [[United States sanctions against Iran]] begin. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/07/iran-currency-plunges-record-sanctions-loom-180729135733789.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*15 people are killed and over 25,000 are affected after heavy floods hits [[Nigeria]]. [https://allafrica.com/stories/201807300329.html (All Africa)]
*11 people died and 54,000 others are displaced when floods hits [[Myanmar]]. [http://www.dnaindia.com/world/report-nearly-120000-displaced-in-myanmar-floods-2643811 (''DNA India'')]
*13 people are killed and four others are injured in a road accident involving a car and a truck in [[Quang Nam]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://en.vietnamplus.vn/quang-nam-serious-traffic-accident-kills-13-injures-4/135525.vnp (VietnamPlus)]
*A man died and 12 others were hospitalized when the [[West Nile virus]] spread across [[Italy]]. [https://news.fidelityhouse.eu/cronaca/zanzara-west-nile-ce-un-primo-morto-in-veneto-e-12-casi-confermati-355684.html (''Fidelity News'')]

;International relations
*[[Italy–United States relations]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] hosts [[Italy|Italian]] [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] at the [[White House]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2018/07/30/live-stream-president-trump-italian-pm-conte-speak-joint-presser/863525002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**Intelligence officials in the [[United States]] share evidence that [[North Korea]] has continued to develop [[nuclear weapons]], despite promises made at the [[2018 North Korea–United States summit]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/us-spy-agencies-north-korea-is-working-on-new-missiles/2018/07/30/b3542696-940d-11e8-a679-b09212fb69c2_story.html?utm_term=.8780196f2666 (''Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Cannabis in Georgia (country)|Cannabis in Georgia]]
**Following a campaign led by Georgian politician [[Zurab Japaridze]], the [[Constitutional Court of Georgia]] legalizes [[Cannabis (drug)|cannabis]] for [[Recreational drug use|recreational use]]. Georgia is the first former [[Republics of the Soviet Union|Soviet Republic]] to fully legalize the drug, with it also being decriminalized in Russia, Ukraine and Estonia. [http://georgiatoday.ge/news/11592/Smoking-Marijuana-Legalized-in-Georgia (''Georgia Today'')] [https://www.rferl.org/a/georgian-constitutional-court-abolishes-fines-for-marijuana-consumption/29399496.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Governor of Indiana|Indiana Governor]] [[Eric Holcomb]] calls for the [[Indiana General Assembly|General Assembly]] to pass a hate crimes bill after a suburban [[Indianapolis]] synagogue is defaced with [[Antisemitism|anti-Semitic]] graffiti. [https://www.sfgate.com/news/crime/article/Holcomb-calls-for-hate-crimes-bill-after-13117011.php (''SFgate'')]
*[[Australia|Australian]] [[Archbishop]] [[Philip Wilson (bishop)|Philip Wilson]] announces his resignation after being convicted for his role in covering up sexual abuse. He is the most senior [[Roman Catholic]] official convicted to date. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-45009807 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Zimbabwean general election|Zimbabwean general election, 2018]]
**Voters in [[Zimbabwe]] go to the polls to elect a new president and members for both houses of the [[Parliament of Zimbabwe|Parliament]], the first election to not involve longtime former president [[Robert Mugabe]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jul/30/zimbabwe-election-robert-mugabes-mnangagwa-chamisa (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Macedonian constitutional referendum, 2018]]
**Lawmakers in [[Republic of Macedonia|Macedonia]] approve a government proposal to set September 30 as the target date of a referendum to change the country's name. [https://www.rferl.org/a/macedonian-lawmakers-vote-name-change-referendum-greece/29398570.html (RFE/RL)]
